title: LRHP: Learning Representations for Human Preferences via Preference Pairs

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing raw win rates against length-controlled win rates on benchmarks like AlpacaEval2 and Arena-Hard to measure the model's algorithmic tendency to disproportionately favor longer responses.

Conducting separate evaluations for each response pair by alternating the order of the two responses (ra and rb) to counteract the LLM evaluator's tendency to prefer an option based solely on its positional placement.
